name: Snake Temple
scope: The standing Snake Temple compound exterior, including the ornate principal shrine frontage, adjoining bays and smaller forecourt building.
era: The historic temple in its present standing form as documented in the 2023 cleared Qualla photograph.

originalReview.notes: Exact Qualla copy of the photographer's original 2023 CC0 courtyard photograph. Establishes the primary portal, layered tiled roofs, coral brick side wings, stone column bases and colorful ridge ornament.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Only the exact cleared Qualla courtyard original is used as photographic evidence. The native building outlines establish side and rear extents.
